name: Upon Dusk
detailed_description:
PLEASE READ FIRST!!

Before we begin, I must make this known. I am a single dev, new to UE5, and this is just a passion project. I am working on a new map, a new player model, and plenty more.

This game uses assets from the FAB marketplace. This game will ALWAYS be free, with no micro-transactions. In the future, dedicated server support may be added, and anti-cheat may be implemented.

Thank you for understand, now, lets get into some of the key features..

-------------------

Key Features:

- Dynamic Multiplayer Survival: Band together with friends or brave the darkness alone. In Upon Dusk, cooperation is optional but survival is not. Each decision can mean the difference between life and death, not just for you, but for your entire squad.

- Unrelenting Enemies: Face off against zombies and bosses alike, will you survive what these lands throw at you?

- Harsh Environments: Navigate through a variety of treacherous landscapes, from dense forests to abandoned cities and desolate wastelands. Weather and time of day dynamically change, impacting visibility, zombie behavior, and survival strategies.

- Base Building and Defense: Scavenge resources to fortify your shelter, set traps, and create safe havens. But beware, no refuge is safe forever. Defend your base against zombie sieges and rival survivors eager to claim what’s yours.

- In-depth Survival Mechanics: Hunger, thirst, and exposure can be as deadly as any zombie bite. Hunt wildlife, gather resources, and manage your inventory to keep the elements at bay.

- Realistic Weather and Day/Night Cycle: Experience the beauty and terror of dynamic weather patterns, including howling windstorms and thick fogs, all affecting game play. The day/night cycle drastically alters the world.

- Customizable Characters and Loadouts: Tailor your survivor with customizable gear, weapons, and skills. Whether you prefer to snipe your enemies from afar, set up elaborate traps, or craft the perfect zombie-proof fortress, Upon Dusk allows you to play your way.

- Unforgiving Terrain: Challenge yourself with navigation and resource gathering in environments that work against you. Cliffs, rivers, and abandoned structures offer both danger and opportunity.

short_description: Upon Dusk is a free-to-play multiplayer survival game with no micro-transactions, ever. Created by a solo dev and using some assets from the FAB Marketplace. Fight zombies, NPC Bandits, and rival survivors, and make sure to come out on top by any means necessary.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-7400 CPU
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements are subject to change.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-13400F 2.50 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3050 or AMD RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: These system requirements are subject to change.

content_descriptors.notes: While you are playing Upon Dusk, you will encounter scenes that include violence and gore. These scenes could be during the time where you control your character, or when there is a cutscene.
